The shared shopping list

For both recipes at their stated two-serving yields. Check your pantry first.

  • 1 can chickpeas + 1 can white beans (15 oz / 425 g each)
  • 150 g cucumber + 150 g cherry tomatoes
  • 90 g baby spinach + 2 garlic cloves
  • 50 g feta + ¼ cup chopped parsley
  • 1–2 lemons, to yield 3 tbsp juice
  • 2 slices of bread
  • Pantry: 3 tbsp olive oil, ¼ tsp oregano, salt and pepper

Sample recipes await kitchen testing. The complete product is still in development; no payment is being collected.

Who is it for?

Home cooks who want a little more variety at lunch and appreciate having the recipes and shopping worked out together. The planned first edition focuses on vegetable-forward everyday meals.

Will the free recipes stay free?

Yes. Our website recipes include the ingredients and method. The paid collection will add coordinated weeks, shopping lists and a convenient printable format.

When can I buy it?

After recipe testing, photography and the finished PDF are complete. We will update this page when it is ready. There is no checkout or pre-order at this stage.
